from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,time,datetime
b=Path.cwd()
completed=[]
for p in sorted((b/"commands").glob("*/commands.json")):
 if p.parent.name=="finalize-handoff": continue
 rows=json.loads(p.read_text())
 for r in rows:
  assert r["state"]=="direct_reaped" and all(r[k] for k in ["bothEOF","closedFDs","ownedGroupAbsentESRCH"]),str(p)
  completed.append({"receipt":str(p.relative_to(b)),**r})
(b/"all-completed-command-custody.json").write_text(json.dumps(completed,indent=2))
before=json.loads((b/"artifact-before.json").read_text())
after=json.loads((b/"artifact-after.json").read_text())
assert before["sha256"]==after["sha256"]
baseline_dir=b/"commands/formal-baseline"
baseline_command=json.loads((baseline_dir/"commands.json").read_text())[0]
baseline_stdout=json.loads((baseline_dir/"formal-baseline.stdout").read_text())
baseline_error=(baseline_dir/"formal-baseline.stderr").read_text()
assert baseline_command["exitCode"]==1 and baseline_stdout["accepted"] and "published-v1.2-provenance.cue:19:33" in baseline_error
negatives=json.loads((b/"negative-results.json").read_text())
manifest=json.loads((b/"official-manifest.json").read_text())
network=[{"read":1,"tool":"web.open","url":"https://slsa.dev/spec/v1.2/build-provenance"},{"read":2,"tool":"web.open","url":"https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1"}]
network.append(json.loads((b/"network-03.json").read_text()))
network.extend(json.loads((b/"network-04-05.json").read_text()))
network.append(json.loads((b/"network-06.json").read_text()))
network.extend(json.loads((b/"network-07-08.json").read_text()))
assert len(network)==8

report="Formal schema validation remains pending. The published SLSA v1.2 CUE summary is the same file used by R3572, so the earlier failure is not evidence that a different provenance version was selected.

The one baseline command first accepted the original artifact under three explicitly limited semantic checks, then executed the unchanged official CUE summary with the existing pinned CUE v0.17.1 binary. CUE exited 1 with:

```
missing ',' in struct literal:
    ./published-v1.2-provenance.cue:19:33
```

This is a schema parser failure before artifact validation. It establishes neither a product defect nor a formal artifact pass.

The published version-specific source is [SLSA v1.2 provenance.cue](https://slsa.dev/spec/v1.2/schema/provenance.cue), 1,275 bytes, SHA-256 `0ddd00372622d1c04f71d1fb2666579af089eb733c9c5d838d158489b2ea6145`. It exactly matches `spec/schema/provenance.cue` at SLSA revision `73fb193723941f4db5b0888aa028f76e50a4c96b`. [The v1.2 specification](https://slsa.dev/spec/v1.2/build-provenance) labels both its CUE and protobuf summaries informative and gives the prose authority. No normative summary was edited. The predicate URI redirected to the v1.1 page during both observations; that redirect does not select a different predicate major version.

The [in-toto repository at 50bf01716982189898823e90586075f37cd9bb7d](https://github.com/in-toto/attestation/tree/50bf01716982189898823e90586075f37cd9bb7d) contains versioned Statement/v1 and SLSA predicate/v1 protobuf definitions. Its complete recursive tree contains no CUE or JSON Schema files; its only JSON files are package manifests. The versioned protobuf definitions explicitly delegate field validation to consumers. Their Statement predicate field is an arbitrary Struct, rather than a binding to the SLSA predicate message. Thus those definitions alone cannot establish the requested complete normative JSON/CUE validation. Go helper validators exist but were not executed or adopted as a substitute.

The exact gap is an executable normative schema for the complete Statement/v1 plus provenance/v1 contract. No usable such schema was found in the examined official definitions. The informative CUE is not executable with the pinned tool, and protobuf data representation is insufficient for complete required-field, version-binding and semantic validation. A custom substitute was not counted as a formal schema pass.

Three independent one-field mutations were actually rejected by the owned, narrowly scoped semantic driver:

| Control | Changed JSON pointer | Actual exit | Rejection |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Statement version v0.1 | `/_type` | 1 | Statement/v1 constant |
| Predicate version v0.2 | `/predicateType` | 1 | provenance/v1 binding |
| Remove first subject digest | `/subject/0/digest` | 1 | Every Statement subject requires a digest |

The unchanged original passed these same three checks in the baseline command. These are semantic controls derived from the official Statement fields and SLSA predicate identifier, not full formal-schema negative controls. No other payload validation attempts ran. The driver, mutations, manifests, exact command arguments, stdout and stderr are retained locally.

The original artifact remained 29,434 bytes with SHA-256 `8b5aef90558f5bee8a852f06f0d50850f43e39e46a63c4957d590236893a9b59` before and after. The baseline validator addressed that original path, without projection. The copied baseline and mutations are owned diagnostic files only.

SLSA source license: Community Specification License 1.0. In-toto definitions: Apache-2.0. Exact source, license and tool digests appear in `official-manifest.json` and `cue-identity.json`; both licenses are retained. The existing CUE binary was reused without reinstallation.

There were eight top-level network read operations: two required web opens and six logged urllib operations. Two urllib reads recaptured those pages as raw evidence. HTTP redirects were followed; underlying redirect hops are not separately counted. All command logs stay in this owned namespace. The CUE help introspection returned an ordinary terminal error for an unsupported help topic; it was not a payload attempt.

No canonical source, source authority, Git/index, dependency manifest, provider, native process, browser, device or child agent was changed or started. No held namespace was traversed. Expected nonzero validator exits had positive direct-reap, both-EOF, descriptor-close and ESRCH observations; no new UNKNOWN or hold was manufactured. No product build or runtime ran.

R3422 remains private, unsigned `verified_subset` evidence. Its earlier 474 semantic checks, two tests, 19 refusals and reopen pass were not rerun. No signature, source authentication, builder trust, complete dependency closure, SLSA level, release, native acceptance or GA claim follows. The parent should keep the formal schema gate pending and may copy the compact local receipt into its owned canonical receipt lane.
"
